title: artemisia dracunculus var. glauca
intro: Artemisia dracunculus var. glauca, commonly known as Wild Tarragon or Russian Tarragon, is a perennial herb native to Eurasia and North America. This plant is valued for its health benefits, particularly in reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Wild Tarragon include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Wild Tarragon include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
